## ReallocationComputeOptions.supplyTargetUtilization property

> Warning: This API is now obsolete.
>
> The supply-target trigger is fixed at 90% ([DEFAULT\_SUPPLY\_TARGET\_UTILIZATION](./morpho-sdk.default_supply_target_utilization.md)<!-- -->) and will stop being configurable in the next major. Per-market overrides are still honored for now.
>

Per-market target utilization above which the shared liquidity algorithm is triggered (scaled by WAD). Overrides `defaultSupplyTargetUtilization` for the specified market.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly supplyTargetUtilization?: Readonly<Record<MarketId, bigint | undefined>>;
```
